soundness_flags.label: Target estimand and def:model-class
soundness_flags.one_line: psi is only described as an identified causal vector, not defined as an observed-law functional; the learner's plug-in ratio does not define tau(P), so the model restriction and target must explicitly give the ratio-of-g-formulas functional and its equivalence under mean-Verma.

soundness_flags.label: Proposition 4 (odd-h witness nonemptiness)
soundness_flags.one_line: The displayed exact gain is said to hold “in span{1,h}” but the required restricted optimizers and restricted variances are undefined, while V_A and V_star denote unrestricted quantities; introduce distinct restricted objects before deriving the unrestricted strict inequality.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: For continuous Z the paper explicitly restricts optimization to a finite-dimensional class generated by prespecified weighting functions, calls the result locally optimal, and says characterizing globally efficient influence functions remains an open problem.

The paper gives Hilbert-space projection geometry and finite-dimensional approximations for a single constraint, and specializes the nested-Markov orthocomplement to the Napkin graph; it does not supply a growing-sieve primitive attainment theorem.
The article studies partitioning-based series estimators, including splines and piecewise polynomials, under compact support, smoothness, density, and conditional-variance regularity conditions.
The paper establishes boundary-adaptive conditional-density estimation with uniform convergence and distributional approximations on compact supports.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Article metadata and summary, pp. C1–C68
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The cited paper exists at the stated venue and develops orthogonal-score and cross-fitting inference with high-dimensional nuisance parameters.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Define psi_x(P) explicitly as the Napkin ratio-of-g-formulas, state that the mean-Verma restriction makes its z-indexed ratio constant, and derive the learner's integrated ratio from that definition.
Add named restricted-span optimizers and variances to the odd-h proposition, then state the finite-span positive gap separately from the inequality transferring it to V_A-V_star.

Make the paper-level delta maximally sharp by proving that the full-arm operator reduces to Guo et al.'s finite-family covariance program on every prescribed family, while a nonzero residual certifies strict global improvement.

recommended_next_step: Repair the two well-posedness defects, then advance the retained field-tier global-attainment kernel to Stage 0.
